title: Prospective falsification of storage-Jacobian fallback trigger
why_these_cases: They perturb timestep around the diagnostic threshold while keeping material, hydraulic state, boundary factor and solver policy fixed. They were not used to select the 1e-8 threshold.
prediction_rule: A case above threshold predicts that lookup theta/C is unsafe for strict nonlinear-path invariance and should use exact retention/capacity. A case at or below threshold predicts lookup theta/C preserves the analytical iteration/backtracking path.
decision_rule: The trigger is falsified by any false negative. Any false positive prevents a clean efficiency claim and must be reported. No threshold adjustment is allowed in F-AHL23.
